description: Na₃Nd(AsO₄)₂ crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3m1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The Na-O bond length is 2.14 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.90 Å. Nd is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NdO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra. All Nd-O bond lengths are 2.32 Å. As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NdO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 15°. There is one shorter (1.67 Å) and three longer (1.73 Å) As-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nd, and one As atom.
